description: This file defines the InitializationFilter class, which is a servlet filter responsible for handling the initial setup process of the OpenMRS application. It manages the first startup initialization, including database setup, user creation, and configuration procedures. The class contains methods for processing GET and POST HTTP requests to guide users through installation steps, resolve configuration properties, verify database connections, and execute setup tasks asynchronously. It also includes nested classes for managing the execution of initialization tasks in a background thread.

classes.name: InitializationCompletion
classes.description: A nested class responsible for executing the initialization tasks asynchronously in a background thread, including database creation, user setup, schema updates, and test data import.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent
methods.description: Loads configuration properties from system, environment, and installation script sources, resolving and prioritizing them to set the wizard model fields accordingly.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to manage the setup wizard flow, rendering appropriate templates based on the current step or request parameters.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Processes form submissions to advance the setup wizard, updating wizard model state, validating input, and initiating installation tasks as needed.

methods.name: startInstallation
methods.description: Starts the background thread to perform the initial database and configuration setup.

methods.name: createTablesTask
methods.description: Adds database table creation tasks to the task list if the user selected to create tables.

methods.name: createDatabaseTask
methods.description: Adds database creation and user setup tasks based on wizard configuration.

methods.name: createSimpleSetup
methods.description: Configures the wizard model with default values suitable for a simple setup mode, primarily used in test environments.

methods.name: autoRunOpenMRS
methods.description: Automates the startup process for OpenMRS for testing or scripted deployment, executing tasks such as database setup and updates.

methods.name: checkLocaleAttributes
methods.description: Adjusts locale/session attributes based on user input during setup.

methods.name: verifyConnection
methods.description: Checks whether the provided database connection parameters are valid and can successfully connect.

methods.name: getRuntimePropertiesFile
methods.description: Returns the file object for the runtime properties configuration file.

methods.name: getRuntimePropertiesFileName
methods.description: Returns the default filename for the runtime properties, depending on environment.

methods.name: skipFilter
methods.description: Decides whether to skip this filter, typically bypassing setup steps if initialization is complete or not required.

methods.name: getTemplatePrefix
methods.description: Provides the path prefix for velocity templates related to initialization.

methods.name: getUpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Returns the model object used to track update progress.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Servlet filter initialization method, sets up the wizard model and checks if database is empty.
